text: Connect the center of green S to the center of pink E with exactly one straight stroke. The pen tip is the center of the dark crosshair, not the yellow handle. All three actions are always offered. In idle, pick lifts the pen. In lifted, move positions the pen without ink and drop anchors a stroke at its current position. In drawing, move updates the stroke and pick finishes the attempt. Other state/action pairs waste a turn. Do not drop until exactly at S; do not finish until exactly at E. In lifted your target is S; in drawing your target is E. After choosing move, answer horizontal and/or vertical comparisons from the SAME screenshot. Left/above keep the lower remaining half, right/below keep the upper remaining half. The rejected current position is excluded and the tip moves to the integer midpoint. Same column/row freezes that axis until drop resets both searches. Locked axes reflect your earlier answers, not verified alignment. Up means toward the top of the image. This is a straight-line tool: while drawing, the visible segment is a live preview from the fixed drop point to the current tip. Previous previews leave no ink; pick commits this segment.
